brief.offer: A fixed-price boiler service for flats, 149 EUR, booked online, done in one visit
brief.audience: Flat owners who have had one breakdown already and do not have a regular plumber
brief.brand_constraints: One typeface, no stock smiling faces, the van is always the real van

assumptions.because: Not supplied, taken from the category the advertiser named
assumptions.changes_if_wrong: The 42 EUR target cost per booking moves with it, and the shortest edit stops being worth testing

evidence.supports: One visit closed the job in 391 of 412 recorded interventions
The price is 149 EUR including parts under 20 EUR

claims.text: Done in one visit in almost every case

creative_lock.insight: The fear is not the price, it is the second visit that turns 149 into an open bill
creative_lock.problem: Nobody quotes a boiler service without a survey first
creative_lock.angle: The quote is the price, and the visit is one visit
creative_lock.promise: You know what you pay before anyone rings the bell
creative_lock.mechanism: Fixed scope, published price list, parts under 20 EUR included
creative_lock.proof: 412 jobs over three months, 391 closed on the first visit
creative_lock.objection: There will be a supplement once they are inside
creative_lock.cta: Book a slot, see the price before confirming
creative_lock.register: Serious and restrained, close to a tradesperson speaking, no music-video energy
creative_lock.hook: 149 euros. Ecrit avant qu'on sonne chez vous.
creative_lock.reason_to_keep_watching: The viewer wants to find the catch, and the ad hands them the catch at 8 seconds
creative_lock.payoff: The same number appears at the end, unchanged, next to the booking button

hooks_considered.text: 149 euros. Ecrit avant qu'on sonne chez vous.
hooks_considered.why: The only one carrying the number in frame one, and the number is the whole argument. It also sets up the payoff literally rather than thematically.

hooks_considered.text: Votre chaudiere ne va pas se reparer toute seule.
hooks_considered.why: Category-generic. Would fit any competitor with the name swapped, which is the definition of a weak hook.

hooks_considered.text: Le devis, c'est le prix. Pas une fourchette.
hooks_considered.why: Strong argument, weak first frame: it needs a second of reading before anything is understood.

script.spoken: 149 euros. Ecrit avant qu'on sonne chez vous. Pas une fourchette, pas un devis apres la visite. On entre, on fait l'entretien, on repart. Sur 412 interventions cet ete, 391 etaient finies en une visite. Les pieces sous 20 euros sont comprises. Le prix que vous voyez maintenant est celui que vous payez. Reservez un creneau, vous verrez le montant avant de confirmer.

scenes.narration: 149 euros. Ecrit avant qu'on sonne chez vous.
scenes.composition: The number occupies the upper third at full weight, the van door fills the lower two thirds slightly out of focus
scenes.subject: The price, as an object
scenes.primary_motion: The number lands from a 4 percent scale overshoot and settles in 6 frames
scenes.secondary_motion: The van door drifts 3 percent left, parallax against the number
scenes.transition: Hard cut on the last consonant
scenes.sound: One low impact on the landing, no music yet
scenes.reframing: In 4:5 the number moves to the optical centre and the van becomes a horizontal band
scenes.legibility_risk: The number must clear the reels caption overlay in the lower fifth
scenes.acceptance: The number is readable at thumbnail size and no part of it enters the bottom fifth

scenes.narration: Pas une fourchette, pas un devis apres la visite. On entre, on fait l'entretien, on repart.
scenes.composition: Three-step horizontal band, each step entering as it is spoken
scenes.subject: The sequence of the visit
scenes.primary_motion: Steps enter left to right, each on its own stressed syllable
scenes.secondary_motion: The completed steps desaturate so the current one holds the eye
scenes.transition: The band collapses into the proof card
scenes.sound: Music enters under the voice at the first step
scenes.reframing: In 4:5 the three steps stack vertically rather than shrinking to fit
scenes.legibility_risk: Step text must not fall below 4 percent of frame height
scenes.acceptance: Each step is on screen for at least 0.9s and the third is complete before the cut

scenes.narration: Sur 412 interventions cet ete, 391 etaient finies en une visite. Les pieces sous 20 euros sont comprises.
scenes.composition: The two numbers sit on a single baseline, the fraction drawn rather than typed
scenes.subject: The record, not the promise
scenes.primary_motion: The counter runs to 391 and stops hard, the denominator already in place
scenes.secondary_motion: A thin rule extends under the fraction as the counter runs
scenes.transition: Cut on the stop of the counter
scenes.sound: The music drops out for the last half second of the count
scenes.reframing: Identical in both ratios, the fraction is centred and the rule shortens
scenes.legibility_risk: The counter must not animate so fast that the end value is the only readable one
scenes.acceptance: The final fraction holds still for at least 1.2s

scenes.narration: Le prix que vous voyez maintenant est celui que vous payez. Reservez un creneau, vous verrez le montant avant de confirmer.
scenes.composition: The opening frame returns unchanged with the button added beneath it
scenes.subject: The same number as scene one
scenes.primary_motion: None on the number, deliberately. Only the button rises into place
scenes.secondary_motion: The van settles back to its scene-one position
scenes.sound: Music resolves and stops before the last frame
scenes.reframing: In 4:5 the button sits to the right of the number rather than under it
scenes.legibility_risk: The button must survive the platform CTA overlay
scenes.acceptance: The number is pixel-identical to scene one and the last frame holds 1s

Brand licence, desktop and embedded video use, on file

loudness_target.source: Advertiser brief, matching their other placements on this channel. Not a platform guarantee; verify against current platform documentation before treating it as one.

engine.name: ffmpeg
engine.why: No video generation capability was connected on this machine. The concept is typographic and compositional, so a deterministic pipeline produces it exactly rather than approximately.

formats.composition: Master composition. Number in the upper third, subject below, captions above the bottom fifth.
Recomposed, not cropped. The number moves to the optical centre, the three steps stack, the button sits beside the price.

defects.observation: The counter reaches 391 before the spoken number arrives
defects.why_it_fails: The proof lands twice, and the second landing is the weaker one
defects.fix: Delayed the counter by 5 frames so the number lands on the spoken word

defects.observation: The payoff frame is deliberately still while the music is still moving
defects.why_it_fails: Not a defect, recorded so the next reviewer does not fix it by accident
